4 اصحّهُ : see 2, in two places. ―
-b2- Also He found him to be صَحِيح [or healthy, sound, or free from disease]; namely, a man. (L, TA.) ＝
-A2- And اصحّ He had his family and his cattle in a healthy, or sound, state; (L, K;) whether he himself were in health or sick: (L:) or, said of a people, or party, they had their cattle in a healthy, or sound, state, after they had been affected by a plague, or murrain, or distemper. (S, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
